title: The winner will be invited to and awarded within the frame of the CSIT World Sports Games 2027!
content:
Dear CSIT Members,

 
Thanks to our already very long-standing and excellent cooperation with Panathlon International and the decision of President Giorgio Chinellato, we are delighted to introduce you again the special award, which will be staged at the [CSIT World Sports Games 2027 in Aalborg Denmark](https://2027.csit-world-sports-games.com/en/): **The Panathlon International Award – CSIT World Sports Games 2027!**

 
Previous recipients include CSIT Honorary President Prof. Kalevi Olin and Avi Sagi of HAPOEL, both of whom were honoured by former PI President Pierre Zappelli at previous closing ceremonies, as well as the most recent recipient, President Elisabeth Speiser, the driving force behind the [global ‘Catch’n Serve Ball’ movement](https://www.catchandserve-ball.com/), who received the award last year from President Giorgio Chinellato.

 
This Panathlon-CSIT WSG Award is in collaboration with our Cooperation Partner PI - Panathlon International. One of the objectives of the award is to encourage, coordinate and promote development of the sporting ideal and of its moral and cultural values, in all the countries where CSIT is established. The Award gives all CSIT Member Unions from the various countries a chance to nominate candidates, who have distinguished themselves in upholding the ethical and cultural values of sport.
By awarding this prize, the organizers wish to acknowledge, reward and celebrate those, who have honoured and advocated such fundamental principles through their example and their actions. The Award is the apex of all the nominations received from CSIT Member Unions, since all of them promote and celebrate sport.

 

* **Nomination deadline** is the **March 05th**, **2027**.


 

* **The winner will be invited to and awarded within the frame of the CSIT World Sports Games 2027!**


 
Further information about the terms and conditions incl. nomination form of the awarding, please find enclosed.

 
In case of further questions, please do not hesitate to contact our colleagues from [Panathlon International](http://www.panathlon-international.org/) via [info@panathlon.net](mailto:info@panathlon.net) anytime.

 
Yours sincerely,

 
**Wolfgang Burghardt**
CSIT Secretary General

 
**[CSIT WORLD SPORTS GAMES 2027 Aalborg](https://2027.csit-world-sports-games.com/en/)**
